response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with strong fundamentals, but the profile does not match the mandatory requirements. C++ exposure is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014–2015, far short of the required 5–10 years of hands-on C++ on Windows. The recent decade is dominated by TypeScript/Node.js, D and web/cloud work on Linux stacks. Database experience is centered on MongoDB and MySQL rather than SQL Server or Oracle, and financial-domain exposure is limited to a fintech (RIDE Capital) role in retail investment tooling, with no fixed income, derivatives, capital markets, or Summit experience. Communication skills and engineering discipline are clear positives, but they cannot offset the core technical and domain gaps.
strengths: Broad senior-level engineering experience with strong TDD/CI-CD and craftsmanship practices
Excellent communication evidenced by conference talks, workshops, and course authoring
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work (millions of requests/sec at Sociomantic)
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience, and over a decade ago
No SQL Server/Oracle depth; database work is MongoDB/MySQL-oriented
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience
